uniprot.transformation: Retain all records and DOMAIN features; replace canonical protein sequence with its SHA-256 and length. Screening requires an exact digest match to a translated reference isoform.

peptides.extraction: All rows whose Gene exactly matches any frozen candidate gene; unmodified cell values and 1-based Excel row numbers retained.

independence: Mergner 2020 draft proteome and Reyes 2026 new experiments are separate biological acquisitions. All peptide identifications used here were processed together by Reyes et al.; independence of computational processing is not claimed.

specificity_background.reconstruction: tools/screen_domain_isoforms.py with pinned full reference and protocol; includes partial CDS translations
